# Sotheby's

> > Sotheby's is a premier international auction house offering fine art, collectibles, and luxury goods through global auctions and private sales.

Sotheby's operates flagship locations in London, New York, and Hong Kong, connecting collectors with masterworks spanning Old Masters, Impressionist, Modern, Contemporary, and American art. The platform provides comprehensive artist biographies, auction results, past lots, and current offerings across diverse collecting categories.

## Key Topics

- Fine art auctions
- Artist biographies and auction results
- Contemporary art
- Modern art
- Old Master paintings
- Impressionist art
- American art
- Global auction locations (London, New York, Hong Kong)
- Past auction lots and sales records
- Art market collectibles
- Private art sales
- Artwork appraisals
- International art market
- Artist sales history
- Auction house services

## Global Locations & Maisons

- [Sotheby's London | Art Auction & Sales](https://www.sothebys.com/en/about/locations/london): Sotheby's London flagship on New Bond Street: auctions and services
- [Hong Kong | Art Auction & Sales](https://www.sothebys.com/en/about/locations/hong-kong): Sotheby's Hong Kong Maison: auctions, exhibitions, and luxury sales
- [Mexico City | Auction, Department and Representatives Locations](https://www.sothebys.com/en/about/locations/mexico-city): Sotheby's Mexico City location: auctions, appraisals, and services
